description: This file implements the 'git reset' builtin command, providing functionality to reset the repository to a specific commit, tree, or state. It includes definitions for command options, core reset logic, index management, and reference updates.

methods.name: int reset_index(const char * ref,const struct object_id * oid,int reset_type,int quiet)
methods.description: Performs the reset of the index to a given tree or commit, handling different reset types (mixed, soft, hard, merge, keep).

methods.name: void update_index_from_diff(struct diff_queue_struct * q,struct diff_options * opt UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Updates the repository index based on a diff of files, adding or removing entries accordingly.

methods.name: int read_from_tree(const struct pathspec * pathspec,struct object_id * tree_oid,int intent_to_add)
methods.description: Reads a tree object into the index, with options for intent to add files and diffing.

methods.name: void print_new_head_line(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Outputs the new HEAD position after a reset.

methods.name: void set_reflog_message(struct strbuf * sb,const char * action,const char * rev)
methods.description: Prepares the reflog message for reference updates during reset.

methods.name: void die_if_unmerged_cache(int reset_type)
methods.description: Checks if there is an unmerged merge state preventing a reset and terminates if so.

methods.name: void parse_args(struct pathspec * pathspec,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,int patch_mode,const char ** rev_ret)
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the reset command, handling revision specifiers, pathspecs, and options.

methods.name: int reset_refs(const char * rev,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Updates the symbolic refs (HEAD and ORIG_HEAD) to point to the new commit after reset.

methods.name: int git_reset_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Handles the configuration for 'git reset' related settings.

methods.name: int cmd_reset(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
